info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Mortgage Loans Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loan Status API provides users with up-to-date information regarding the status of their mortgage loans. By utilizing this endpoint, loan officers and consumers can easily track and monitor the progress of their applications. This resource is essential for stakeholders who require transparency and timely updates in the mortgage process. Typical use cases include checking application approvals, processing stages, and outstanding requirements to ensure an efficient experience.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of loans. It provides details on loan applications, including whether they are pending, approved, or rejected, helping users track their loan processes effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of loans. It should contain any necessary parameters in the specified JSON format to query the loan status effectively.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the current loan status.
